prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / Korean game announcement poster.
Create ONE premium portrait announcement poster for the existing Korean fantasy collection game 숲켓몬, exact 2:3 portrait composition, highest available resolution. A finished announcement users can post directly.
Input images are supporting compositing references, not canvases to edit: image 1 is the official DUO CHALLENGER trophy; images 2–5 are four representative official duo emblems: bronze, platinum, grandmaster and challenger respectively. Preserve their distinctive twin-core/twin-heart silhouettes, rank colors and crafted metal appearance. Do not turn them into other generic logos. No new characters or fake gameplay screenshots.
Art direction: rich obsidian/navy arena architecture, subtle electric blue light and restrained gold rays, dramatic large beautiful official trophy as the central hero, elegant vertical proportions, sophisticated Korean game launch key art with excellent typography. The trophy must remain a trophy with its base, entire silhouette visible. Composition must feel like a premium game event poster, not a website dashboard, plain infographic, or a stack of generic rounded cards. Use generous negative space around all copy; actual designed typography, clean crisp Hangul, high contrast ivory titles and restrained lime functional accents. Two joined streaks of light may suggest cooperation around the trophy. Intricate artwork but quiet dark surfaces directly behind text.
Hierarchy: small game name at top, massive main title, short subheadline, trophy hero. A prominent 24-hour recruitment ribbon and four well-spaced short rules in the middle/lower region, using editorial dividers rather than boxes. The four supplied emblems form one beautiful compact supporting row below the rules; keep them secondary to the trophy. A short line explains that there are eight duo tiers; these four images are representative samples, not a complete tier listing. A gold-blue challenger reward callout at bottom. Keep all text inside safe 5% margins.
Render exactly the following Korean copy (the line breaks below are intentional guidance); no extra explanatory prose, no dates, no invented URLs or launch claims:
숲켓몬
랭크 듀오
혼자 접속해도, 함께 싸운다
2인 1팀 · 비동기 랭크전
24시간 참가 모집
강자 + 성장 중인 유저 자동 팀 편성
네 사람의 덱, 하나의 전장
덱·장비는 매 경기 최신 반영
행동력은 각자 사용
일반 랭크전과 같은 충전 규칙 · 별도 차감
랭크전 시즌 연동 · 자동 모집·종료
브론즈부터 챌린저까지
새롭게 탄생한 8종의 듀오 티어
[Bottom reward callout:]
최종 상위 20팀, 두 사람 모두
듀오 챌린저 트로피 지급
Print no bracketed instruction text. Keep readable sizes even on a phone. Do not crop any title or emblem. No watermark, mockup frame, QR code, app buttons, fake sponsorship, invented reward amounts or invented dates.
revisionPrompt:
Edit this exact existing Korean game poster. Preserve the arena background, hero trophy, main 랭크 듀오 title, all explanatory copy and overall composition. Only these precise corrections:

The word should be optically centered, immediately legible, with natural Korean typography. Do not render 숩 or 술 or 슾.
2. Change the bottom reward line from "최종 상위 20팀, 두 사람 모두" to exactly "최종 상위 10팀, 두 사람 모두". All references to the challenger reward must be ten teams, never twenty.
3. In the small representative rank strip, the rightmost icon labelled 챌린저 should be the correct flat shield emblem from supporting image 2, not a miniature trophy. Keep the large hero trophy untouched.
Preserve all other text verbatim, including 24시간 참가 모집 and 새롭게 탄생한 8종의 듀오 티어 and 듀오 챌린저 트로피 지급. Keep portrait aspect ratio and resolution. Crisp legible Korean, no new copy or redesign.
